title: US loses measles-free status after continued spread of the disease: Report
paragraphs: US loses measles-free status after continued spread of the disease: Report
The reported decision by the Americas branch of the World Health Organization comes as the US battles the highest number of measles cases it has seen in more than three decades.

The Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) has revoked the United States' measles-elimination status, ending a 26-year run after determining the country failed to halt continuous transmission of the highly contagious virus for more than a year, the Wall Street Journal reported on Friday (Nov 13).
